items.title: ChatGPT adds Locked Chats with PIN or biometric unlock

items.summary: Feral Interactive《Hitman: Absolution – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition》將於 10 月 22 日發行：更高解像度、60fps Performance、Joy-Con 滑鼠操作；Switch 版限時免費升級至 11 月 5 日。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 15 11:19 AM EDT → +08:00. Launch discount until Nov 5 per article.
items.imageAlt: Hitman Absolution Switch 2 Edition key art

items.title: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.3 ‘Journey to the Sky’ launches October 21
items.summary: miHoYo《絕區零》3.3「Journey to the Sky」將於 10 月 21 日更新：新代理人 Phoenix／Severian、機甲戰鬥同天空島主線，PC／主機／手機同步。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 9 8:55 AM EDT. Update day Oct 21.
items.imageAlt: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.3 promotional art

items.title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest dated for October 23 on PC and Switch 2
items.summary: Trailmark／Bamtang《Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest》將於 10 月 23 日登陸 PC、Switch 2／Switch、PS5 同 Xbox：以貓戰士小說為藍本嘅回合制 RPG，四氏族各有獨立劇情。
items.note: Upcoming Oct 23 multiplat; filed as news (not same-day Oct 20–22 launch). Gematsu Sep 1 10:08 AM EDT.
items.imageAlt: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest release date art

items.title: Cotton Reboot! arrives on Switch 2 and PS5 October 22
items.summary: Clear River Games《Cotton Reboot!》將於 10 月 22 日推出 Switch 2 同 PS5 版（實體／數位）：可愛射擊「cute 'em up」，可選 HD Reboot 或 X68000 原版模式同音軌。
items.note: Gematsu Jun 4 9:00 AM EDT announcement; release still Oct 22 2026.
items.imageAlt: Cotton Reboot Switch 2 and PS5 announcement art

items.title: Japan-only PS5 Digital Edition Midnight Black opens for pre-order at ¥55,000
items.summary: Polygon 報道 Sony 日本限定 PS5 Digital Edition Midnight Black 已於 10 月 20 日開放預購，售價約 55,000 日圓（約 350 美元），11 月 19 日出貨；主機同 DualSense 為啞黑，只支援日文介面同日本 PSN，另有約 11,980 日圓黑色光碟機配件。
items.note: Source published Oct 20, 2:31 PM EDT → HKT Oct 21 02:31. Japan language/account locked.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Midnight Black console

items.title: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut coming to Xbox Series on November 3
items.summary: Gematsu 報道 ZA/UM 間諜 RPG《ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut》將於 11 月 3 日同 PS5、Switch 2 一齊登陸 Xbox Series；導演版含約 4 萬字新劇情、Backstage Mode、新 Dramatic Encounter，以及完整英文配音修訂。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 20 1:31 PM EDT → HKT Oct 21 01:31. Also in ID@Xbox showcase recap.
items.imageAlt: ZERO PARADES Director's Cut Xbox announcement art

items.title: PlayStation Plus October Game Catalog goes live with Horizon Forbidden West and Mafia: The Old Country
items.summary: GAMINGbible 指 10 月 20 日起 Extra／Premium 目錄加入《Horizon Forbidden West》、《Mafia: The Old Country》同日首發《Mycopunk》；Premium 另有《Dino Crisis 2》同《RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 Complete Edition》。部分地區仍用分階段上架。
items.note: Catalog announced Oct 14; this is same-day 'now live' coverage. publishedAt from 17:00 GMT+1 Oct 20 → ~00:00 HKT Oct 21. Mycopunk day-one was in Oct 19 skip as announcement—kept as part of live catalog wave.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Plus October catalog games artwork

items.title: GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 among 11 titles leaving PlayStation Plus soon
items.summary: GameSpot 報道《Grand Theft Auto V》同《Red Dead Redemption 2》將喺未來數週離開 PS Plus Game Catalog，連同《The Talos Principle 2》等合共約 11 款；作者推測與 11 月 19 日《GTA 6》發售有關，具體下架日未公布。
items.note: Exact removal dates unknown per GameSpot. publishedAt: Oct 20 8:15 AM PDT → 23:15 HKT.
items.imageAlt: Red Dead Redemption 2 screenshot

items.title: CRITICAL REFLEX brings Arctic Eggs to Xbox today; Mouthwashing and No, I'm Not a Human follow
items.summary: 喺 ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase，《Arctic Eggs》即日登陸 Xbox Series X|S；心理恐怖《Mouthwashing》10 月 29 日連同 Game Pass 上架，銷量逾 80 萬份；《No, I'm Not a Human》則預告 2027 年登陸 Xbox 同 Game Pass。
items.note: Arctic Eggs available Oct 20; Mouthwashing Oct 29; No I'm Not a Human 2027.
items.imageAlt: CRITICAL REFLEX Xbox titles key art

items.title: PlayStation Blog details Final Fantasy Resonance Visions system ahead of October 22 PS5 launch
items.summary: PlayStation Blog 喺 10 月 20 日深入介紹《Final Fantasy Resonance》嘅 Visions 系統：玩家可收集 26 名歷代 FF 角色作戰鬥輔助同永久屬性加成，並喺破防後發動 Resonance 必殺；遊戲將於 10 月 22 日登陸 PS5。
items.note: Hands-on feature dated Oct 20; launch Oct 22 PS5. Exact post time not shown → noon HKT placeholder.
items.imageAlt: Final Fantasy Resonance Visions feature art

items.title: AMD and Microsoft announce FSR 4.1 coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox Ally
items.summary: Windows Central 報道 AMD 公布 FSR 4.1 將登陸 Xbox Series X|S 同 Xbox Ally 系列；CTO Scott Van Vliet 稱主機版「即將推出」，Ally 端有消息指 10 月 23 日經 Armoury Crate 預覽。技術以 ML 升頻換取更高幀率。
items.note: Exact Series X|S rollout window not given ('coming soon'). Ally Oct 23 preview per ROGAllyLife cited in article. publishedAt date-only → T00:00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: AMD FSR 4.1 upscaling performance chart

items.title: Report: next Xbox Project Helix targets 2028 holiday at $1,200–$1,800
items.summary: VGC 引述 Fortune 對 Xbox CEO Asha Sharma 嘅專題，指下一代主機 Project Helix 瞄準 2028 年假期檔，內部估價約 1,200–1,800 美元（除非補貼）；另指 2027 年假期檔有新一代掌機，以及 Game Pass 或改為可自選功能加購。
items.note: Single-source Fortune report via VGC; prices internal projections. publishedAt: 20 Oct 8:31 pm UK BST → ~03:31 HKT Oct 21. Category other (industry/hardware roadmap).
items.imageAlt: Xbox hardware imagery used by VGC

items.title: Former Treyarch designer says Black Ops ports' success is 'hard to watch' without creator royalties
items.summary: VGC 報道前 Treyarch 關卡設計師 Gavin Goslin 喺 LinkedIn 指《Black Ops》同《Black Ops 2》PS4／PS5 移植大賣（據估 7 月約 1120 萬套、4.35 億美元），但原班創作人員「一分錢都冇」，促請對長壽作品提供追溯分紅。
items.note: Sales figures attributed to Alinea Analytics via VGC. publishedAt: 20 Oct 1:00 pm UK → ~20:00 HKT.
items.imageAlt: Call of Duty Black Ops gameplay still

items.title: Global Esports exits competitive esports, rebrands as AI-focused GE Studios
items.summary: Offstage 報道印度戰隊 Global Esports 結束電競業務並解散 VALORANT 陣容，全體球員自由身；聯合創辦人 Rushindra Sinha 指公司將以 GE Studios 品牌轉攻遊戲產業 AI 專案。GE 剛贏 VCT Pacific Stage 2 並打入 Champions。
items.note: publishedAt uses site stamp Oct 20 09:51 AM (timezone not labeled; kept as +08:00 with note).
items.imageAlt: Global Esports VALORANT team photo

items.title: Griffin Gaming Partners and Entertainment 360 launch HITpoint for game-to-film/TV adaptations
items.summary: GamesBeat 報道遊戲創投 Griffin Gaming Partners 同人才管理／製片公司 Entertainment 360 成立 HITpoint Entertainment，專做遊戲 IP 影視改編；會結合 Griffin 開發商關係同 360 嘅製作網絡，並強調遊戲創作者由開發到製片全程參與。
items.note: Posted Oct 19; within 48h window from Oct 19 07:00 HKT. No slate/projects named yet.
items.imageAlt: Griffin Gaming Partners office

items.title: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 shrinks to four days, cutting Friday
items.summary: GamesBeat 報道 Informa 宣布 GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 改為 3 月 1–4 日共四日（取消傳統星期五），會議同 Business Hall 週一至四、Festival Hall 週二至四；稱按出席數據集中喺社群最活躍日子，並擴展較低價通行證同獎學金。
items.note: Posted Oct 19. Event dates March 1–4 2027 at Moscone, San Francisco.
items.imageAlt: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 four-day schedule graphic
